row.evidence: Workiva's pricing page has no public plans ("Please reach out to a sales representative"), and its SCIM help article documents SCIM 2.0 provisioning that creates, suspends, reactivates and deletes users and manages roles and workspaces through IdP groups.
row.notes: Quote-only: no public tiers or prices; pricing is customised per organisation and all offerings include unlimited seats/users, so per-user prices are null. SCIM 2.0 is documented in the help centre (Org Security Admin sets it up under Organization Admin > Identity & access management > Provisioning) with no plan named; SAML SSO is likewise documented without a plan. Okta's OIN app provisions with Basic Auth; Entra needs a custom non-gallery app with a bearer token because the gallery app does not support SCIM. Deprovisioning suspends the user; Entra should not be set to Delete. The Workiva REST API (OAuth2 client credentials, 10-minute tokens) has organization user, role, workspace and group endpoints plus an activities (audit) API; the pricing page lists Open APIs as included with every plan.

plans.name: Workiva platform (custom quote)
plans.notes: No public tier table. The FAQ mentions good/better/best packaging for some solutions; every offering includes unlimited seats or users. Open APIs are listed under 'Included with every plan'.

auth.token_source: Organization Admin > Identity & access management > Identities > Provisioning > Add Identity or API (Identity Provider); the SCIM API user then regenerates the Basic Auth secret / Bearer token under My Profile > Security
auth.notes: Two credential types: Basic Auth (ID + secret; the only type the Okta OIN app supports) and Bearer Token (Entra, custom Okta apps). The base URL is the per-provisioning URL shown in Organization Admin; no pattern is published.

operations.notes: 'Import new users' lets the IdP read existing Workiva users (read). PUT vs PATCH is not documented.

deprovision.data_retained: User is suspended, not deleted; Workiva says it will not delete user profiles from Entra and only deactivates them. Separately, the Okta 'Delete users' feature removes users from the platform.
deprovision.notes: Seats are unlimited on every offering, so seat release is moot.

attributes.notes: From the Okta and Entra mapping tables. The error-message table also mentions timezone, locale and office phone values.

roles.how: SCIM groups named by convention: role:<role name> (organization role), workspace:<name> (membership), workspace:<name>:role:<role> (workspace role), workspace:<name>:group:<group> (workspace group). The SCIM API user can only grant roles it already holds.

limitations.text: Entra ID: the Workiva gallery app does not support SCIM; a custom non-gallery application is required.
The Okta OIN app only supports Basic Auth; only linking Okta groups to existing SCIM groups is supported.
Users invited from another Workiva organization (auditors, external counsel) cannot be managed by SCIM.
First name, last name, display name and email are required; diacritics are not allowed in name fields.
Workspace role/group assignment fails if the user is not a workspace member within about 30 seconds.
Workiva only supports commercially or freely available SCIM clients.
Very large user counts (10,000+) make SCIM and bulk user operations significantly slower.

auth.notes: API grants are created by an Org Security Administrator (Organization Admin > Identity & access management > Provisioning > Api Grant) or a workspace owner; bearer tokens last 10 minutes. EU, APAC and Canada have separate base URLs.

endpoints.purpose: Assign an existing user to the organization
Partially update a user (givenName, familyName, displayName, username, email)
Delete a user from the organization
Add a user to a workspace

rate_limits.text: Load-based rate limiting with HTTP 429 and Retry-After; 10 MB payload limit; 29-second request timeout.

okta.notes: OIN page markup marks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push as checked.

entra.notes: Workiva says its Entra gallery app does not support SCIM; provisioning works through a custom non-gallery app against the generic endpoint. No Microsoft Learn tutorial was found for Workiva.

onelogin.notes: Workiva names OneLogin among SCIM-enabled IdPs; OneLogin's own catalogue was not checked (bot protection).

fallbacks.notes: SAML SSO setup supports mapping existing users to SSO IDs through a .csv file, but a CSV user import was not confirmed.

conflicts.text: The SCIM article lists 'Delete users: Remove users from the Workiva platform' as a supported feature, while its Entra section says Workiva won't delete user profiles and will only deactivate them.

open_questions: Which Workiva packages include SCIM and SAML SSO is not published (quote-only).
SCIM base URL pattern, ServiceProviderConfig/Schemas support, PUT vs PATCH, pagination and SCIM rate limits are not documented publicly.
Whether a SCIM suspension ends active sessions is not documented.
Whether the Workiva API exposes user-event webhooks is not documented in the Admin API reference.
Google Workspace and JumpCloud catalogue entries were not verified.
